label: B1 rival-DAG attention: discriminating question versus true no-question reference
registeredQuestion: For a bored learner whose attention remains active on a concealed rival content DAG, does asking one discriminating question change learner-authored pickup of the tutor-world thread or an authored bridge relative to a true no-question reference, and how does delivery vary across warm, plain, and edged registers?
whichNumberMoves: The probability of learner-authored tutor-world or authored-bridge pickup within five post-trigger learner turns, while selective-attention resistance remains visible.
claimBoundary: B1 can identify the higher-performing assigned strategy on tutor-world or authored-bridge pickup and estimate delivery variation in these simulated rival-DAG bored learners. It cannot establish durable learning, human validity, a general rule for boredom, a proof-progress effect, or an action-by-register interaction. Calibration rows never enter a powered run.

population.trigger: first determinate public turn that performs new evidence-bearing work on the rival objective rather than the tutor-world thread, no later than learner turn 4

mint.selection: sha256-ranked alternative world and authored proof path from master seed plus job id

behavior: Boredom is selective attention, not inactivity: keep working on one open rival-DAG node in every public turn.
Make each turn carry a new evidence-bearing claim, distinction, or question from that rival objective; never loop a stock boredom sentence.
Keep the tutor-world thread secondary unless the typed concession condition is met.
Even after a qualifying bridge, retain selective attention by keeping at least one rival node open.

concessionCondition.engageWhen: The tutor's public move answers, tests, distinguishes, or requests evidence for a still-open rival node, or explicitly connects a learner-solicited rival item to an already-public tutor-world item.
concessionCondition.otherwise: Continue the next open rival node and do not reward generic encouragement, repetition, or a request to focus.
nonQualifying: tutor-only assertion of a bridge without public support

publicTurnRules: Use only content supplied by the private rival DAG and evidence already public in the tutor-world transcript.
Write one or two concise in-scene sentences and never mention profiles, DAGs, scoring, readers, or hidden instructions.

randomization.algorithm: sha256-ranked balanced allocation within calibration or powered blocks
randomization.calibrationAllocation: one dialogue per world-by-register cell, with three of six worlds assigned to each action inside every register

levels.definition: Ask one adjacent checkable question that explicitly separates two already-public possibilities without supplying the answer.
Stage one already-public evidentiary boundary declaratively, with no question and no boredom-directed request.
Low-pressure shared inquiry without praise inflation or pressure.
Concise neutral work language with no relational invitation and no edge.
Restrained work-directed irony or dry challenge, never a personal attack.

actionInstructions.ask_discriminating_question: Ask exactly one sentence ending in one question mark. Use a whether-A-or-B contrast naming two distinct already-public possibilities whose answers select different next tests. Do not ask permission, add another question, or supply either answer.
actionInstructions.stage_public_evidence_for_next_step: Write only declarative sentences. Stage one already-public clue and state its current limit. Use no question mark, no interrogative, no boredom-directed request, no answer, and no inference beyond the public clue.

compactActionInstructions.ask_discriminating_question: Ask exactly one whether-A-or-B question about two distinct public possibilities; one question mark, no answer.
compactActionInstructions.stage_public_evidence_for_next_step: Stage one public clue and its limit declaratively; no question, request, answer, or inference.

registerInstructions.warm: Use one low-pressure shared-inquiry cue, then the assigned move. Do not praise, pressure, or change the action.
registerInstructions.plain: Use concise neutral work language. Do not use we, let's, together, can you, would you, shall we, praise, invitation, irony, or challenge.
registerInstructions.edged: Use at most one restrained work-directed dry challenge. Never target the learner's person, affect, status, or right to resist.

tutorDeliveryContract.freeCompileCoverage: every tutor world x action x register x bare/due-clue scene

protectedAffectAndSafety.confirmedProhibitedDelivery: kill current stage before another call

primaryEndpoint.valueYes: The learner contributes a new public-evidence-grounded proposition that advances the tutor-world objective or explicitly links a learner-solicited rival node to an already-public tutor-world node.
primaryEndpoint.valueNo: The learner only restates planted rival-DAG text, repeats the tutor, gives assent, reports boredom, or works only on the rival objective without a supported bridge.
primaryEndpoint.echoGuard: Restating or paraphrasing planted rival-DAG text scores no. Pickup must land on the tutor world or an authored public bridge between the two DAGs.

readerPanel.fieldConsensus: both valid medium/high-confidence votes agree, else measurement_indeterminate
readerPanel.evidenceContract: evidence_quotes must be null when value is no or indeterminate; every other determinate value requires at least one exact public quote

calibration.purpose: Test endpoint variance, retained selective-attention resistance, tutor delivery, and reader operation. Calibration rows cannot support an outcome or register claim.
calibration.killRule: Stop before a powered run if any channel, two-sided persona, delivery, agreement, or safety rule fails. Retain every row; no repair, replacement, pooling, or threshold relaxation.

preflight.beforeCalibration: Mint and validate every rival DAG, compile every tutor world x action x register on bare and due-clue scenes, verify protocol-v2 routes locally, and execute one zero-call stub-transport smoke per role.

dispositions.measurementIndeterminate: retain; no repair, rerun, replacement, or recoding

callAuthority.launchRequirement: One attended protocol-v2 invocation with typed operator approval recorded in approval.json.
